name: sarama-broker-response-admission-and-quarantine
instr:
Sarama cannot detect decoded Kafka broker responses that contradict their requests before changing client state. Add opt-in semantic admission for metadata, produce, and SASL handshake responses, sharing one deterministic model while preserving schema semantics and existing behavior by default.

`github.com/IBM/sarama` exposes `ResponseAdmissionMode` with `ResponseAdmissionDisabled = iota`, `ResponseAdmissionReportOnly`, and `ResponseAdmissionReject`, plus `ResponseViolationKind`. Configuration defaults to disabled, accepts only those modes through `SetResponseAdmission`, and rejects others during `Config.Validate` before connection activity.

`ValidateBrokerResponse` returns an independent `ResponseAdmissionReport` containing every `ResponseViolation`, including API key, version, stable kind, request-relative location, and detail. Findings follow request order; mismatched API types are typed violations.

Metadata admission rejects unusable topology relationships and unexpected successful topics before cache consumption, reports duplicate broker IDs and topic-partition identities in decoded order, and leaves protocol topic errors to normal handling. Produce admission compares acknowledgements with the sent batch, deterministically finds missing and unexpected results, and validates version-gated leader hints. SASL admission validates successful mechanism negotiation and content without mutating decoded values or reclassifying protocol, correlation, decoding, or wire failures.
